title: Started out OK, but became progressively harder to use
text:
Started out OK, but became progressively harder to use. I am guessing that the rotary blade set becomes quickly dull. When I first received this opener it zipped through opening cans and was very easy to use. Now it sometimes takes an additional pass to open a lid, Sadly I have only been using this for two weeks.

Second issue is the requirement to hand wash it. I didn't catch that in the product description when I made the purchase decision. I resolved that issue by ordering AmazonCommercial brand openers that were literally half the price (and I ordered tree; two for the house and one for trips.)

Overall I am disappointed. If it winds up breaking like many other reviews claim it will I will simply return it because at least the return window is long (purchased in October 2021, can return as late as February 2022.,)
